snippets.text: ## Asia 30-day Enjoy unlimited talk & text within your destination and back to Canada. Plus, use the data from your rate plan while travelling. Add Travel Pass in MyBell or text ASIA30 to 4400 . Important notes: * The pass is immediately activated once you add it to your account and it expires 30 days later at 11:59 p.m. (ET). Make sure you add the pass the day your trip starts, before you arrive. * The pass is compatible with Roam Better and takes priority over Roam Better when travelling in an eligible destination (i.e., if you're using an active Travel Pass, you won't be charged the Roam Better daily fee). * Once the pass expires, you revert to your regular roaming option (e.g., Roam Better or pay-per-use rates). * Each Travel Pass has a 30-day duration. snippets.text: ## What to expect on your bill If you don't have a travel add-on (Roam Better or Travel Pass) * If you don’t have Roam Better – with home data or a Travel Pass, you'll be billed according to the pay-per-use rates applicable to your destination when you make or receive a call, send a text or use data. * To calculate your out-of-bundle usage, see the billing details provided on your bill. * Voice calls and data while roaming are reflected through the use of Coordinated Universal Time (UTC). UTC is the primary time standard by which the world regulates time. * Text messages sent while roaming are reflected through the use of Eastern Time ET. Note: Pay-per-use data roaming will no longer be available as of May 1, 2026. If you have Roam Better – with home data * For destinations not covered by Roam Better, you'll be billed according to the pay-per-use rates applicable to your destination when you make or receive a call, send a text or use data. Roam Better customers require a Data Travel Pass to use data in destinations not covered by Roam Better. Note: Data Travel Pass will no longer be available as of March 19, 2026. Pay-per-use data roaming will no longer be available as of May 1, 2026. * Voice calls and data while roaming are reflected through the use of Coordinated Universal Time (UTC). UTC is the primary time standard by which the world regulates time. * SMS while roaming are reflected through the use of Eastern Standard Time ET.
